project.name: Primitive
release_notes: TimeMatch preserves user-added Apple event details, conditionally mutates owned Microsoft events, and keeps bounded Microsoft all-day busy spans local to their actual dates. Credentials use zeroable Exchange secret headers.
Google disconnect distinguishes an already-invalid submitted credential, while deterministic Google and Apple create recovery can safely finish a previously unapplied attempt under provider guards.
Calendar parsing unfolds lines in linear work, invitation output writes physical lines once, and Temporal resolves exact civil-day bounds including the native leap-year boundary correction.
Go module observations include the native per-version lock carrier address. Native proofs cover actual Go lock interoperability; this does not enable any consumer shared cache by itself.
